title: Sagalee Mormii
intro: Namni jalqabaa lafa irra osoo hin deemin yeroo dheeraa dura, uumamni humna guddaa qabu tokko naannoo nagaa guutuu ta’e keessa dhaabatee, lubbuuwwan baay’ee of kennaniin marfame. Ajajni tokko yeroo kennamu sagalee hunduu bitamuudhaan ni jilbeenfata ture-garuu sagalee tokko mormiidhaan ka’a, mormiin sun immoo hanga Guyyaa dhumaatti bara hundumaa keessatti ni dhaga’ama ture. Uumamni kufe kun eenyu?
clues: Ani waan ifaan gubatu irraa kan uumame yoo ta’u, warri na cina jiran kaan immoo waan irra deeman irraa kan uumamanidha.
Uumama of kenne gidduutti bakka qulqulluu tokkon jiraadhe, hanga ajajni tokko waan hundumaa garagalchutti.
Yeroo ajajni dhufu lubbuun hundinuu anaaf malee ni sagade; diduun koo of tuulummaa irraa dhalate.
Bakka qulqulluu sana keessaa, abaarsa bara baraan turuun mallatteeffamee ari’ame.
Hanga Guyyaa Qiyaamaatti yeroo kadhadheen, nuuf kenname. Lubbuu hundaatti dhiyaadhee karaa irraa akkan isaan geessu dhaadadhe.
Yeroo xurumbaa dhaga’amu warri na hordofan hiree koo qooddatu, ibidda boba’aa bakka gargaaraan tokkollee isaan oolchuu hin dandeenyetti na waliin ta’u.

arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verse: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few." (17:62)
